name: 碎音爬客
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE original enemy combat-body sprite for a 2D industrial-fantasy action RPG set in abandoned resonance mining shafts. Cohesive premium hand-painted game art: sculptural light, elegant original anatomy, coal-dark stone, ivory mineral, oxidized copper accents, restrained cyan/amber crystal bioluminescence. Detailed material craftsmanship with broad readable forms, NOT photorealistic noise. This is the Resonant Deepwell biome, a strange mineral ecology responding to vibration. Entirely original, no existing IP or artist reference.
Camera and usability: elevated top-down three-quarter view looking down about 40 degrees, complete creature in a poised combat stance facing lower-right, solid weight and clear contact points where applicable. Body needs to read at 70 pixels high: strong distinct silhouette, large contrast blocks and one or two iconic skill organs, not many decorative tiny spikes. ONE subject only. Square canvas, complete extremities visible inside central 76 percent with generous transparent border. True transparent alpha cutout; solid interiors virtually opaque, alpha near255, narrow edge antialiasing only. No ground, pedestal, floor shadow, background, smoke, halo, text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, border, logo, watermark, inset diagrams or other creatures. Do not bake gameplay markers or attack paths into the sprite. No gore, no anime, no chibi.
M28 "Shard-Sound Crawler" / 碎音爬客: a SMALL low skittering mineral creature with EXACTLY SIX overlapping flat stone plates stacked into a smoothly ARCHED BACK, and six fine pointed CRYSTAL LEGS spread out from underneath like tense tuning needles. No humanoid face, no mushroom, no shell spikes. The six plates are broad little charcoal-grey slate shingles with pale weathered bevels, stepped so the count is readable from above. The front two leg pairs angle forward, rear pair springs backward; all feet complete. Legs share a clear pale cyan internal glow as a simultaneous pre-charge tell, with amber at the joints; their apparent delicate sharpness contrasts the heavy curved slate back. A single narrow warm sensing slit under the front plate suggests listening for the last sound location, and a small ivory acoustic cavity beneath the arch is its exposed soft point. The pose is low and coiled for one short dash, not leaping. Broad clean slate surfaces, only selective chips and mineral seams, distinct silhouette like a little bowed stone bridge walking on fine crystal needles.
originality: Original project visual and behavior specification, no external IP references.

qa.review: One full-body creature in elevated three-quarter combat pose, clear unique skill organ, no text, backdrop or baked gameplay markers.
qa.limitations: Static body only. Movement, facing variants, attack frames and runtime 70px readability require integration work.
qa.alpha_method: System.Drawing GetPixel stride4, visible alpha>16, near-opaque alpha>=240; actual outer edges checked at every pixel.
